svg.aria-label: The March 2025 tj-actions attack as a chain. A malicious pull request on SpotBugs ran through a pull_request_target workflow, which stole a maintainer token, which gave write access to SpotBugs, then Reviewdog, then tj-actions/changed-files, whose version tags were moved to a malicious commit, which reached over 23,000 repositories using a version tag and printed their secrets into the workflow logs. Fix 1, never checking out PR code in a pull_request_target job, cuts the chain at the start. Fix 2, pinning actions to a commit SHA, cuts it before the repositories. Fix 3, a read-only GITHUB_TOKEN, does not stop the leak but limits it.
svg.text: March 2025, one pull request, a few hops
tags moved to a bad commit
fix 1, never check out PR code
fix 2, pin actions to a commit SHA,
so a moved tag cant reach you
cant stop the leak, only shrink it
